title: carlina vulgaris var. maritima
intro: Carlina vulgaris var. maritima, commonly known as sea carrot, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family, characterized by its distinctive yellow flowers and medicinal properties. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Carlina vulgaris var. maritima include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions, including wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and polyacetylenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-cancer activities.
